title: Alliance Outdoor Products Recalls Climbing Treestands Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The cable assemblies on the treestand can separate due to corrosion, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 3,400.

title: Coulter Ventures Recalls Rogue Home Timers Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Rogue Fitness
summary: The lithium-ion battery inside the timer can burn due to overheating, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 8,900.

title: Target Recalls Toddler Boots Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The toggle on the boot can detach from the elastic lace, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 122,500.

title: Walker Edison Recalls Chests Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The recalled drawer chests are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that may result in death or injuries to children. The chests do not comply with the performance requirements of the U.S. voluntary industry standard (ASTM F2057-19). Units: Ab

title: YETI Recalls Rambler Travel Mugs with Stronghold Lid Due to Injury and Burn Hazards
summary: The magnet slider on the lid can eject and hot contents can spill out, posing injury and burn hazards. Units: About 241,500.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicle's clutch can fail, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 18,400 (In addition, about 560 units were sold in Canada).

title: InvoSpa Recalls Heated Blankets Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled blankets can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 7,050.

title: Zinus Recalls Bunk Beds Due Fall and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The welds that secure the upper bunk can come apart, causing the upper bunk to collapse, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 26,000.

title: Arena North America Recalls Swim Snorkels Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The swim snorkels can release excess material from inside the tube or mouthpiece, posing a choking hazard to the user. Units: About 3,350 (In addition about 3,500 were sold in Canada and 3,100 were sold in Mexico).

title: Bolek's Craft Supplys Recalls Wintergreen Essential Oil Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The product contains the substance methyl salicylate, which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a poisoning risk if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 5,600

title: Fire Pit Tables Sold Exclusively at Big Lots Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Manufactured by Sunjoy
summary: An incorrectly installed burner kit hose can melt and ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 10,900.

title: Kohl's Recalls Three-Wick SONOMA Goods For Life Branded Candles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The candle's high flames can ignite the surface of the wax or cause the glass to break, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 512,000.

title: Quality Bicycle Products Recalls Salsa Cycles Cutthroat Bicycles Due To Injury Hazard
summary: The bicycle's fork legs can crack or break, posing a fall hazard to the rider. Units: About 600 (In addition, about 100 were sold in Canada).

title: Ring Recalls Video Doorbells (2nd Generation) Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The video doorbell's battery can overheat when the incorrect screws are used for installation, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 350,000 (In addition, about 8,700 were sold in Canada).

title: Eco Baby Spoons and Forks, Eco Feeding Spoons, and Eco Placemat Feeding Sets Recalled Due to Choking Hazard; Made by Herobility
summary: The Eco Baby Spoon and Fork and Eco Feeding Spoon can break into small pieces, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 890 (In addition, about 11 in Canada).

title: Lidl US Recalls Powerfix Steel Shelving Units Due To Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The recalled shelving units can be missing wall mounting hardware, which is used to attach the shelving unit to the wall to prevent it from tipping or falling, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards. Units: About 4,000.

title: RH Recalls Wine Barrel Chandeliers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: Hardware parts used to hang the chandeliers can break causing the chandelier to fall from the ceiling, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 7,800 (In addition, about 600 were sold in Canada).

title: Santa Cruz Bicycles Recalls Bicycles with Aluminum Frames Due to Fall Risk
summary: The aluminum frame pieces could have experienced thermal damage during a non-standard paint stripping operation and can bend or buckle, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 2,900 (In addition, about 216 were sold in Canada).

title: Towsleys Recalls 3-in-1 Qi Wireless Chargers, Power Banks and Travel Chargers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The chargers and power banks can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,500.

title: Any Volume Recalls Bicycle Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury; Sold Exclusively on ebay.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The helmets do not comply with the U.S. CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 660.

title: Crock-Pot 6-Quart Express Crock Multi-Cookers Recalled by Sunbeam Products Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled Crock-Pot multi-cooker can pressurize when the lid is not fully locked. This can cause the lid to suddenly detach while the product is in use, posing burn risks to consumers from hot food and liquids ejected from the product.
